content:
ari: Heads-up: planning a small canary for the new engine+quant profile tonight 23:00 UTC (2h window). Need an owner for rollout and smoke checks. Details: will target slice slab-7, 1 node, ~10% traffic.

devon: I can own the rollout. Who's on rollback? Also what's the exact quant id we are pushing?

sasha: rolling profile is `q8_2_slim-v3`. Model pins unchanged. KV-cache warms retained.

mike: For rollback we need a snapshot id + a quick revert playbook. I'll prepare `revert.sh` and a short runbook and attach to the ticket.

jules: Prefer we run a dry-prefix smoke before the switch: `--prefix=short` => ~200 reqs, stretch traffic patterns. I'll run at 22:30 UTC. Anyone object?

devon: lgtm. I'll coordinate canary metrics: p50/p95, error-rate, token/sec. Monitor dashboard `runtime/canary/engine-q8`. Will set alerts for +20% latency or +5% error rate.

ops-bot: Booking deploy window: 2026-05-05 23:00-01:00 UTC for team eng-runtime. Channel: #eng-runtime. Ticket: DP-4821.

ari: Quick checklist: 1) owner (devon) 2) smoke @22:30 (jules) 3) rollback ready (mike) 4) perf metric hooks (devon) 5) notify SRE on-call. Anything to add?

sasha: Add: confirm quant-profile checksum `sha256:ab3f9e4d2c1b6f...9c1` and validate with `./tools/verify-profile --id q8_2_slim-v3`.

mike: I'll upload `revert.sh` to the deploy artefacts and attach to DP-4821. Also pin the canary slice to avoid autoscale rotation during the bake.

devon: I'll post a short note to #oncall before flip. Abort criteria: +20% p95 or +5% errors sustained for 2 mins -> immediate abort + rollback.

ari: Perfect. If no blockers I'll start preflight at 22:00 UTC (basic health checks, `kv` warm check, and smoke harness dry run). Ping me if you want to join handoff.

jules: I'll be on standby for smoke and initial drift checks. :thumbsup:

devon: noted. I'll open a tiny PR for the deployment manifest that sets canary size and bake time, linking DP-4821.

mike: reminder: set `KV_CACHE_TTL=2h` for the slice so warm doesn't get huge during the test.

ari: Thanks all — will post short updates during the window and final status once we close.
